question: What should come in the place of blank number (1)?
solution:
The correct answer is '**instantiated**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes a world where human actions are the result of "systems of predictive design" and "algorithmic interpellation" rather than free will.
 
• "**Instantiated**" (उदाहरण द्वारा स्पष्ट करना/मूर्त रूप देना) means to represent as or provide an instance of a concept or theory. In computer science and philosophy, it refers to the creation of a concrete instance of an abstract object. In this context, it suggests that human actions are simply concrete "instances" generated by an underlying algorithm.
 
• "**Rationalized**" (तर्कसंगत बनाना) means to justify or explain a behavior with logical reasons. While humans might rationalize their actions, the blank describes the nature of the action itself as an "emergent behavior" calculated by a system.
